task: predict whether Qolumbina DOSS detects each seeded buggy variant on the ideal simulator in a majority of available random-seed runs
positive_label: detected in at least half of report runs; each report is positive if any of its named tests has test_result=fail
negative_label: not detected in a majority of report runs
group_split_unit: original Qolumbina program; all variants and backends of a program remain together
feature_policy: mutant Python source with comments/docstrings removed plus pre-run backend token; no test report output, measured circuit statistic, seed-specific output, or program identity token appended
limitations: 26 program groups limit the precision of grouped-fold estimates
label is the majority empirical DOSS detection rate over available seeds, not a ground-truth semantic bug-fix label
Qolumbina variants are seeded synthetic mutations, not real bug reports
scope: ideal backend only; one row per mutant variant
